title: Diagnostics Before You Wake Up
tagline: Scheduled checks. Quiet unless it matters.
outro: Wake up to answers, not alarms.
script: Three a.m. Something breaks on your server. Who notices first? Give IronClaw the night shift. A routine runs on whatever schedule you set — every five minutes, if you like. Each run, your agent works through your checklist: disk, memory, processes, logs — real shell commands on the machine you've pointed it at; sandbox or host is your runtime profile to choose. Nothing wrong? It stays quiet — you told it to. But when a check fails, it digs in, gathers the evidence, and delivers the report to your chat: what it found, where, and the likely cause. So the first thing you see isn't an alarm — it's the investigation. Wake up to answers, not alarms.
